size_basis.static stripped: Jet, Rust, C, Zig, Go and asm on non-web entries, where the language can build that way: bytes of a static, symbol-stripped build of the same program (C: gcc -O2 -static -s; Rust: -C target-feature=+crt-static -C strip=symbols; Zig: ReleaseFast -fstrip; Go: CGO_ENABLED=0 -ldflags='-s -w'; Jet and asm: their static binary, stripped), counted only after it reproduces expected output
size_basis.stripped + shared libraries: a compiled program with no static build (the static build fails, still links dynamically, changes the output, or the entry overrides the build command): bytes of its stripped binary plus every shared library it loads, libc and the dynamic loader included (by ldd); the row names why the static build was not used
size_basis.web artifact: Jet and Rust on web entries: bytes of the emitted .js, .mjs and .wasm artifacts
size_basis.bundle: Vite: bytes of the bundle vite build writes to dist/
size_basis.script+runtime: Python, Node and Bun: bytes of the program's script files plus the interpreter executable and every shared library it loads, libc and the dynamic loader included (by ldd)
